verdict.rationale: Revisit AR-2: gate must clear (remove) a marker with detectedAt older than latest succeededAt instead of only ignoring it; also address AR-1, AR-3, AR-4 from arch-review.

Expand scope: also close the metrics-writer/OTLP-forwarder marker race (AR-3) so a marker written with the old session after sign-in cannot block the next prompt or start a second browser; also address AR-1 and AR-2 and plan notes.

Expand scope again (AR-3): wire the shared 'credentials superseded' check into the remaining MetricsSender construction sites (hook start/end, desktop runtime, codex/pi/opencode and other uploaders), not only the daemon session-sync; also AR-1, AR-2 and plan notes.
User approved spec after 4 review rounds; single PR; AR-1 (single store-read deadline) goes to the plan.
Fix CR-001 (readWithDeadline stuck flag: allow a fresh read after the deadline) and CR-002 (JSDoc on new public cookie-auth exports).

User wants two more fixes before approval: DF-001 (initial store read has no deadline) and the CR-001 impact note (refresh() consumes the new sign-in stamp before the read, so a null/failed read spends the signal). No third automated review round; fixes get Stage 7 qa-gates.
User approved after check round (CR-001/CR-002 resolved); DF-001 and stamp-spend note fixed afterwards without a further automated round, verified by unit suites + typecheck.
